functions.post_condition: Returns 'success' only if the user's pending request took one ticket while the remaining stock was positive; returns 'sold_out' when no ticket remained; a repeated call for an answered request returns that first answer without changing remaining, sold or the request; across all calls the number of successful orders never exceeds the initial stock and sold plus remaining equals the initial stock.

results.reasoning: In the atomic variant the reservation is one conditional UPDATE (remaining > 0) inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; the request status check makes a retry return the first answer. The check-then-act branch is judged under its own spec.
One SELECT of remaining and one UPDATE of requests.seen; no other table is written.

gaps.spec_claim: Returns 'success' only if a ticket was still remaining when it was taken.
gaps.actual_behavior: Decides on the value the user saw at read time and decrements unconditionally, so two users who both saw one remaining ticket both succeed and remaining becomes -1.
